responsibility: Provides the macro-invocation token-source instantiation of the gccrs templated parser by explicitly instantiating `Parser<MacroInvocLexer>`. Its responsibility is to reuse the generic Rust recursive-descent parser over the lexer that presents tokens for macro invocation parsing, producing the parser specialization used when gccrs parses Rust syntax in macro-expansion contexts rather than from the ordinary source `Lexer`; unlike the main lexer instantiation file, this one is specific to `rust-macro-invoc-lexer.h` and macro-invocation token handling.
